title: The Nightwalker
description:
A little origin addon I made for fun
made with: https://www.mathgeniuszach.com/apps/origin-creator/
body:
**The Nightwalker**

*Not everyone is built for daylight. This origin flips the usual survival loop — you're weaker during the day and stronger at night, with a few tools to manage the gap.*

---

**Solar Flare**
Daylight isn't your friend. Standing under open sky during the day applies Darkness II and Slowness II. Stick to shade, caves, or covered paths. The sun's always there — you just learn to work around it.

---

**Nocturnal Energy**
Once the sun sets, things even out. At night you get Speed II, Strength II, and Jump Boost II. Exploring, fighting, building — it all feels better in the dark.

---

**Coffee Rush**
For when you absolutely need to cross open daylight, there's coffee. Activating it blocks Solar Flare for 5 minutes and gives you Speed II, but it comes with a 10-minute cooldown. Plan around it.

---

**Lunar body**
Your height changes with the time of day. During daylight you sit at 0.80 scale — smaller, easier to overlook. At night you stretch to 1.20. It's just how your body works.

---

**Power Nap**
Sleep works differently for you. Activate this power anywhere, no bed needed. You get a brief moment of darkness, then wake up fully healed, fully fed, with the time of day flipped. Day to night, night to day — whenever you need it.

---
